onboarding.slide3.body: Browse shops neighbourhood by neighbourhood, in your city — and soon in other cities.
onboarding.slide4.title: Follow the forum
onboarding.slide4.body: Discover the news posted by merchants and comment on their posts.
onboarding.slide5.title: Create your business account
onboarding.slide5.body: Post your products or services to be found close to you.
onboarding.slide5team.title: Help NetBuis grow
onboarding.slide5team.body: Create your business account or join the NetBuis team to sponsor new merchants.

business.create.title: Create my business account
business.create.note.boutique: Shop: for a shop, a small supermarket or any small business at a fixed place — name, photos, sector, then the products you sell.
business.create.note.entreprise: Company: a dedicated path — legal form (SARL, SA, GIC...), then business sector.
business.create.note.prestataire_service: Service provider (technician, home tutor, independent medical services...): a dedicated path with a service category and identity check (ID card).
business.create.note.structure: Venue: for a supermarket, a restaurant, a hotel or a health centre — venues with their own details to fill in (specialities, rooms, opening hours...), different from a simple shop.
business.create.note.particulier_vendeur: Individual seller: a simpler path, like a shop but without a formal structure.
